spec.rationale: Types the owner-earnings leg of the operating_business_and_net_assets prose falsifier for CrowdStrike (69.04 USD per share low / 108.98 base / 190.19 high). The low-case owner_earnings_reinvestment_dcf proof trace locks normalized owner earnings at 1,310.241 USD millions (FY2026 anchor per normalized_owner_earnings_ttm_m_v2 and the FY2026 10-K). If trailing-twelve-month normalized owner earnings at 2026-10-31 resolve below that anchor, distributable owner cash has fallen below the low-case bridge and bounded per-share value should compress toward the low case. Incremental after-tax ROIC and reinvestment-rate legs remain judgment inputs without a resolvable SEC metric and are not typed here. Historical adapter replay on Q3 FY2026 (measurement end 2025-10-31, filed 2025-12-03 per CRWD/investor-documents/DOWNLOAD_MANIFEST.json) resolved 1,173.348 USD millions via sec_companyfacts_ttm. Interim Q1 FY2027 TTM at 2026-04-30 (filed 2026-06-04 per manifest) resolved 1,505.198 USD millions, above the anchor. Target Q3 FY2027 TTM is not observable at registration (2026-10-20). Component fingerprint unchanged; work-item input digest rebinding (d1679cacf76599c4f888c341608307c8c8d1c757) and contract_hash 49c4379339951fac9c7ba403d3fdd54edadf9586234e9dcf3986ecf0e98b27fe — forecast threshold and probability were not adapted to post-cutoff evidence. A 24% fire probability weights post-incident recovery and subscription durability against the prior-year Q3 replay below the anchor.
